technique_name: Generate a summary of the passage in less than 20 words
description: Brazil researchers discover new species of blackbird near Rio Tapajos with distinctive feathers and call.
example: Brazilian researchers have discovered a previously unknown species of blackbird in the Amazon rainforest. Found near Rio Tapajos, the blackbird has a distinctive patch of chestnut-coloured feathers and a distinctive call described as a ‘harsh scolding’.
